scope: scripts/qualify_library_integrate_apply.py --candidates on a --component-qualification Host from Debug builds of c9fc8ca3, seven cases each in its own owned de-DE-only CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 scratch: a fresh PLC component after the last network of an existing FBD time-of-day OB (OB10), time-delay interrupt OB (OB20), hardware interrupt OB (OB40) and diagnostic error interrupt OB (OB82); and in a cyclic-interrupt OB (OB30) as a LAD OB, after the first of two networks, and reusing the FB a verified standalone install put into the project. Each preview named exactly obCaller, its obEventClass feature and its combination, and each install passed the exact installed-object diff, the native caller insertion proof, the call oracle, a fresh reopen, a 0-error compile and change_restore of the initial checkpoint into a new location.
limitations: OB fixtures are Main's envelope with the event class, number and informative inputs replaced; OB attributes and event attachments keep V21's defaults (the hardware interrupt OB is attached to no channel).
Only these seven shapes; other combinations of event classes with LAD, earlier placement or reuse, and event classes not named here, stay plan-only.
